summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) announcing the record date for its previously disclosed spin-off of wholly owned subsidiary AI OKTO CORP., its LPG carrier business. The record date is October 1, 2026, with distribution expected on or about October 8, 2026; shareholders receive one AI OKTO share per eight Toro shares held. Completion remains subject to the Form 20-F being declared effective and Nasdaq listing approval. Nasdaq due-bill trading applies from the record date through distribution. Watch effectiveness timing, listing approval, and when-issued trading for arb.
